scope: Publicly discoverable Polypedilum vanderplanki / Pv11 literature relevant to direct post-rehydration cell-cycle entry from 0-96 h.
result: Within the public sources located in this search, no sufficiently dense matched direct EdU/BrdU, S-phase, mitotic-index, phospho-H3, or flow-cytometric cell-cycle-state time series was identified that establishes the first post-rehydration cell-cycle event in Polypedilum/Pv11.

what_public_sources_do_provide.behavioral_function: rapid whole-larva recovery on approximately an hour scale
what_public_sources_do_provide.damage_state: non-equivalent lesion/assay clocks including hours-scale oxidative-damage recovery and slower fat-body alkaline-comet fragmentation recovery
what_public_sources_do_provide.bulk_proliferation: multi-day Pv11/Pv11-derived living-cell-count series demonstrating later population expansion
what_public_sources_do_provide.survival_vs_growth: Hsf perturbation separates post-rehydration survival from the later proliferation-rate observable
what_public_sources_do_provide.transcriptomics: public rehydration transcriptomes at R3/R24 and R3/R12/R24/R72 provide molecular-state proxies but not direct cell-cycle events

public_machine_readable_routes.type: Pv11 RNA-seq associated with Hsf/desiccation-rehydration study

next_action.computational: Preregister and run a cell-cycle transcript-proxy analysis on public rehydration transcriptomes without treating it as direct S-phase/mitosis evidence.
next_action.decisive_empirical: Obtain or generate matched direct 0-96 h cell-cycle-entry data with lesion-class-specific damage state, viability, founder number and bulk growth in the same system.
